hints.title: Monotonic Font Fitting Property
hints.text: If a sentence fits on screen at font size S, it is guaranteed to fit at any smaller font size.

hints.title: Screen Height and Width Invariants
hints.text: For size S, fontInfo.getHeight(S) must be <= h, and sum(fontInfo.getWidth(S, ch) for ch in text) must be <= w.

hints.title: Binary Search on Available Fonts
hints.text: Binary search over the sorted fonts array to identify the largest size that fits.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each binary search step evaluates string width in O(L) time across O(log F) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every font size sequentially from largest to smallest takes O(F * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over sorted font sizes minimizes font metric queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Binary search over sorted answer space with monotonic fit predicate.
